reuse.why: Threads the flag through the existing guard and the shared linkBankSyncAccount, but copies the unlink field reset from unlinkAccount instead of extracting and calling a shared helper.

duplication.why: The eight-field db.updateAccount reset in linkBankSyncAccount duplicates the one in unlinkAccount, so 'what unlinked looks like' now has two definitions.

placement.why: The takeover lives in the shared linkBankSyncAccount, the right layer, though an 'assert' function now also returns the holder ids to act on.

scope.why: Only the flag, the guard, the shared link function and a release note.

maintainability.why: The copied unlink reset can drift from unlinkAccount, the guard's name no longer matches its role, and the flag must be passed to both the early per-provider guard call and the shared one.
